claims.text: Additionally, the release expands ransomware protection to Linux, adds YARA memory scanning, and includes 143 AI-specific security detection rules.
claims.support_span: Ransomware protection for Linux Elastic Defend’s behavior-based ransomware protection now extends to Linux YARA memory scanning Bring your own YARA rules to scan process memory ... 143 AI security detection rules

items.title: The discussion of AI in gaming is pernicious now.
items.summary: Post Ethan Mollick emollick.bsky.social did:plc:flxq4uyjfotciovpw3x3fxnu The discussion of AI in gaming is pernicious now. The idea that games are going to be the only field where humans write code unassisted is obviously wrong. But the push for that from press & fans means missing a chance to guide AI usage toward approaches that empower workers & help gaming thrive.
